verdict.rationale: Zulip's core design explicitly organizes every message into a named topic per channel, with docs describing this as the key mechanism for parallel, non-interrupting conversations and search/filtering by channel+topic. Multiple community voices strongly endorse this as superior to Slack threads for catching up on busy channels, but others report real usability friction (confusing UX for non-technical users, messages posting to wrong threads, subpar polish) that could hinder an admin trying to efficiently catch up.
